definitions.explanation: A senior military officer rank. In the army and air force, equivalent to colonel. In the navy, equivalent to captain. Part of the Japanese military rank system based on three grades: 大 (senior), 中 (middle), and 少 (junior).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧{大佐|たいさ}だった。
{大佐|たいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執|と}った。
examples.english: The colonel took command of the unit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大佐|たいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧な⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{導|みちび}いた→導く：12361_michibiku⟧。
examples.english: In the war movie, the colonel protagonist led a difficult operation to success.

notes:
USAGE:
The Japanese military rank system uses a three-tier structure with {佐|さ} (field officer) grades: {大佐|たいさ} (senior), ⟦{中佐|ちゅうさ}→中佐：18358_chuusa⟧ (middle), and ⟦{少佐|しょうさ}→少佐：18357_shousa⟧ (junior). In the army these correspond to colonel, lieutenant colonel, and major.

In the navy, {大佐|たいさ} corresponds to captain (not to be confused with army captain, which is ⟦{大尉|たいい}→大尉：27402_taii⟧).

Commonly encountered in war films, historical fiction, and military discussions. Also used when translating foreign military ranks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧{大佐|たいさ}: army colonel
- ⟦{海軍|かいぐん}→海軍：13289_kaigun⟧{大佐|たいさ}: navy captain
- {大佐|たいさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to colonel
